exposure: mothers' knowledge of the adequacy of breast milk for infants up to 6 months of age
cohort: The participants were mothers in the neonatology unit of the Abobo Houphouet Boigny Regional Hospital Center with an average age of 26.56 +/- 5.05 years.
finding: Only 15.4% of mothers practiced early breastfeeding, and a key factor identified was mothers' knowledge of the adequacy of breast milk for infants up to 6 months of age.
